note: Status describes repository implementation only. A feature is not live until its external setup and tests are verified.

stages.title: Stage 1 — Dashboard ও PWA foundation
stages.summary: Responsive dashboard, navigation, PWA shell এবং service-worker update flow repository-তে আছে।

stages.title: Stage 2 — Supabase Auth ও Global Community
stages.summary: Auth, profile, member search, friend request, private chat ও group chat-এর frontend/SQL ভিত্তি আছে; production test নিশ্চিত নয়।
stages.requires: প্রথমে base SQL, community SQL apply; Supabase Auth email settings ও end-to-end security tests

stages.title: Stage 3 — Privacy & Data Rights
stages.summary: Consent sync, append-only consent event এবং access/correction/deletion request queue-এর code/migration যোগ হয়েছে।
stages.requires: Privacy migration apply, authenticated tests, deletion fulfilment workflow, policy ও legal review

stages.title: Stage 4 — AI Assistant ও Image Search
stages.summary: AI Edge Function foundation আছে; provider integration live নয়।
stages.requires: AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY secret, provider/model configuration, function deployment ও response/license tests

stages.title: Stage 5 — Facebook Discovery ও Active User Finder
stages.summary: বর্তমানে UI/plan; real discovery চালু নয়।
stages.requires: Meta app, approved permissions/data access, consent-first manual workflow ও policy review

stages.title: Stage 6 — Referral, Notifications ও Admin
stages.summary: কিছু schema/UI foundation আছে; reward, delivery ও privileged operations verified নয়।
stages.requires: Fraud-resistant referral rules, notification provider, server-side admin authorization ও audit tests

stages.title: Stage 7 — Android APK
stages.summary: Android WebView wrapper ও debug build workflow আছে; release artifact/install/signing verified নয়।
stages.requires: Debug build artifact, device test, protected release signing key ও release build

stages.title: Stage 8 — Google Play Store
stages.requires: Developer account, signed AAB, store listing, privacy declarations, policy review ও Play approval
